title: V2 Documentation
body:
This issue tracks the different tasks to do in order to release the v2 of instantsearch.js

 - [x] Integrate documentationjs in the documentation pipeline (metalsmith)
 - [x] Read and generate pages for connectors
 - [x] Read and generate pages for widgets
 - [x] Read and generate pages for commons (instantsearch, basic structures like widget and connectors)
 - [x] Landing page
 - [x] integrate examples + pimp with advanced features (SFFV, show more)
 - [x] Create connectors guide
 - [x] Create upgrade to v2 guide
 - [x] publishable in /v2 (update v1 doc to notify of the v2)?

The [new documentation](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/) is available.
